//: Scouting log for the nightly template-expansion runbook (docs/runbooks/nightly-template-expansion.md). EVERY video vetted gets an entry - including rejects, so nights don't re-vet the same launches. Engagement fields are whatever the source exposes (upvotes, views, likes); record the numbers seen and the date seen, since they drift.

videos.title: Hyperagent, by Airtable — agents platform launch
videos.metrics: 13,807,500 views; 3,826 likes; 4,624 bookmarks; 336 replies; 246 reposts; 80 quotes (X, via fxtwitter API; author @howietl, 330k followers, posted 2026-02-19)
videos.reason: OVERTURNED on human review (2026-08-05): not a launch film. It is a raw screen capture of the product dashboard — a feature demonstration attached to a high-engagement announcement tweet. No produced layer at all (no type beats, no camera work, no edited cuts, no brand cards), so a rebuild is 100% product-slot placeholders with nothing to learn. The 13.8M views belong to the announcement, not to film craft. IGNORE for template work; do not re-vet.

Video downloaded successfully (39.9 MB, 89 s, 3840x2160) and frames extracted to c:/Users/Yasir/Desktop/Code/OpenDemo/.demo-build/nightly/undefined/vet/cand-1-frames/.

videos.title: Proliferate — coding agents for end-to-end company work
videos.metrics: 325 likes, 61 replies (verified via X syndication API); ~69.5k views claimed in candidate notes, not independently verifiable; posted 2026-02-23 by @ycombinator
videos.reason: Rejected on two grounds: (1) humans=dominant — video is a founder talking-head vlog: full-frame live-action person in ~5 of 11 sampled frames including open/close, and a persistent webcam PiP bubble over every UI segment, so it cannot be rebuilt as screen UI/product shots/kinetic type; (2) engagement is weak for X — 325 likes on the ~2M-follower @ycombinator account (~0.47% of claimed 69.5k views) is well below the genuinely-high bar.

videos.title: Celltype — agentic drug company launch
videos.metrics: Original post: @ycombinator on X, created 2026-02-18T16:00:02Z. Verified via cdn.syndication.twimg.com tweet-result API (x.com HTML blocked, HTTP 402): favorite_count=231, conversation_count(replies)=20; view count not exposed by that API — candidate note claims ~44.7k views, unverified. No higher-engagement original found: CellType's own YC launch page (ycombinator.com/companies/celltype) shows no upvote/engagement counters, and no @celltypeinc post of this video with better numbers surfaced. Seen 2026-08-05. Context: ~0.5% like/view rate on a ~1M-follower account; YC launch tweets that break out land in the thousands of likes / hundreds of thousands of views. The often-cited "7M+ views" belongs to Sundar Pichai's earlier Cell2Sentence post, not this launch video.
videos.reason: Reject on engagement only. 231 likes / 20 replies (~44.7k claimed views) on the @ycombinator launch post is middling for X — not a clear standout, and engagement is the filter. Craft-wise it would have been a good clone target: 71 s, 1920x1080, zero live-action people across 10 sampled frames — the whole film is kinetic typography (all-caps grotesque, word-per-beat cuts, stat counters like "75%", stacked light/bold pairs) over stock nature plates, macro lab shots and 3D cell/tumor renders, closing on a Sundar Pichai pull-quote card. Downloaded fine (21.4 MB) but note video.twimg.com only resolves over IPv4 here: curl -4 is required, plain curl hangs and exits 28.

videos.title: Cluely — viral launch/ad film ('soham parekh gets away with it')
videos.metrics: Verified via Twitter syndication API: 7,817 likes, 438 replies (2025-07-03 post by @im_roy_lee, Cluely founder). Views not exposed by API; candidate notes report ~736.7k views, consistent with verified likes.
videos.reason: Engagement is genuinely strong for X (~737k views, 7.8k likes on a startup ad), and the 4K file downloaded fine, but 8 of 11 sampled frames are live-action people dominating the frame — a nine-actor video-call grid and a hooded actor with a handwritten "SOHAM PAREKH" sign — with only a 3-frame Cluely logo end card of rebuildable kinetic type. Predominantly live-action narrative, so rejected per the humans rule.
